sources.title: Independent hand derivations and transparent seed/holdout counterexample
sources.details: For finite logits and T>0, z_i>z_j iff z_i/T>z_j/T iff exp(z_i/T)>exp(z_j/T). Dividing all candidates of one query by its common positive denominator preserves this ordering and ties. Denominators differ between queries, so this proof gives no cross-query p_max ordering. Let a=log(3)/T and s=exp(a). Class probabilities are s/(s+2),1/(s+2),1/(s+2), with gold frequencies 3/5,1/5,1/5. Mean NLL L(a)=log(exp(a)+2)-(3/5)*a. L'(a)=s/(s+2)-3/5, so s=3 and T=1; L''(a)=2s/(s+2)^2>0. The 33-point grid 0.25*2^(k/8), k=0..32 includes T=1 at k=16. L(1)=-0.6 log(0.6)-0.4 log(0.2)=0.9502705392332347, displayed 0.9503. At T=1, maxima for [4,0,-2], [3,0,-2], [2,0,-2] are about .97963, .94650, .86681. The first two policy rows and row 3 pass tau=.9; row 4 is below .9, row 5 predicts none, row 6 predicts insufficient. Thus accepted=3, errors=0, coverage=3/6. For tau=.5..85, 4 accepted including row 4 error, risk=1/4>.05; tau=.95 or .975 accepts only 2; tau=.99 accepts 0 and is excluded because risk undefined. The maximum-coverage feasible grid choice is .9. Original wording accepts rows 1 and 2 correctly; none row stays in denominator: coverage 2/3, risk 0/2. New wording accepts row 1 with wrong class and row 3 with falsely predicted information sufficiency; row 2 is below .9: coverage 2/3, risk 2/2. Pooled final uses counts, 4/6 coverage and 2/4 risk, rather than averaging subgroup risks without weights. Changing only new-wording row 3 info_pred to False rejects it. New wording retains row 1, still wrong: coverage 1/3, risk 1/1. Pooled final accepts 3/6, errors 1, risk 1/3. T and tau remain fixed. Changing a random seed does not enforce disjoint templates or combinations. A generator G(s) that always uses template t and selects scenario id s mod 2 gives identical template and scenario combination for seeds 0 and 2. Different seeds therefore need not yield a held-out template or combination. Correct family grouping would keep this duplicated family together; one must explicitly group and exclude the objects whose novelty is claimed. A disjoint-family split may still share every template.

issues.source_quote: 同生成器換seed只算模板或組合留出。
issues.details: 「不是新來源留出」的方向正確，但只改seed不保證模板或組合在資料分工間不重疊，不能直接命名為模板／組合留出。即使情境家族切開，各家族仍可共享所有模板。官方grouped-CV明確要求欲聲稱未見的group在training fold完全未出現；seed只是抽樣控制。透明反例G(seed)使用固定模板、情境id=seed mod 2，seed 0與2仍是同模板同組合。此句會把隨機重抽樣誤報為較強留出，關係本節核心評估主張，需要收緊。

evidence.supports: 真正unseen-group測試要求分組完全不重疊，而非僅改亂數seed。
存在不同seed仍重複同模板及同情境組合的直接反例。

issues.suggested_change: 改成「同生成器只換seed，仍屬同來源的重新抽樣；只有明確按模板或組合分組、排除重疊時，才可稱模板／組合留出。」可保留前句真正新來源須另留來源的要求。

factual_accuracy.details: Read the full frozen lesson and all explicit prerequisites; 26 claims verify, but c22 incorrectly labels a mere seed change as template/combination holdout. Preserve this necessary issue in the original report.

numeric_verification.details: Executed the exact inline code, checked all nine displayed output lines against the frozen text, independently checked closed forms/NLL optimum and manual denominators, reran the exact info_pred exercise. T=1/tau=.9; original and exercise counts all match. No empirical model-quality claim was inferred.

figure_consistency.details: The complete 9.18 snapshot contains no image or SVG reference, and the exact freeze figure map is empty. The two explicitly linked 9.10 prerequisite SVGs were nevertheless rendered to Git-external PNGs and actually viewed; their axes, positions, scale and labels agree with that prerequisite prose, without revalidating its historical experiment.

source_verification.details: Personally fetched/read Guo PMLR final §4 and Eq9, exact linked Kev commit 2074cc4 metrics.py, arXiv1705.08500v2 risk/coverage and finite-sample assumptions, scikit-learn1.7.2 grouped-CV official docs, and pinned Kev source definitions. Receipts record URL/pin/locator/date/excerpts/SHA; no candidate summary is treated as authority. The pinned README confidence-order claim is rejected in favor of the transparent counterexample.

limitations.details: The text appropriately labels all scores as artificial and separates empirical policy risk from population guarantees, final tuning, information prediction and class correctness. CPU execution establishes only this arithmetic and pinned software behavior. The remaining seed/holdout label overstates the novelty established by random resampling; it must name an explicit exclusion split before claiming template/combination holdout.

scope_and_limits: Independent technical review of 9.18 only; full explicit 9.9–9.10 and 9.13–9.16 prerequisites read as context. No author PLAN/OUTLINE, other reviewer report, reader answer or sidecar was read.
No GPU, long training, paid service, model modification, checker modification, publication, active-pointer change or commit.
No actual language model inference or measured quality/generalization result; no formal family confidence interval was computed.
Current notebook main cell and its freeze hash were checked; remote Colab installation/setup was not executed.
The schema self-check is a separate receipt and does not prove claim completeness or factual correctness.
